_comment: The chatbot-exclusive discount. Business-editable: change the code, the
percentage or the wording here and the bot follows, with no code change.
IMPORTANT - this file is deliberately NOT indexed as a retrievable snippet.
The offer is sent by the state machine as a fixed message, never written by
the model. If the LLM could see it, it would paraphrase it, and a
paraphrased discount is a wrong discount: a hallucinated percentage or a
mistyped coupon is a promise the business has to honour or publicly break.
discount_is_maximum=true renders the offer as 'up to N%' and quotes the
best-case price as 'as low as', because a coupon that MAY give less than
its headline must not be shown as a fixed final price - the customer would
reach checkout expecting a number we never actually promised.
Set "enabled": false to switch the offer off everywhere immediately.
direct_payment is the better-than-BOTDEAL route: the customer pays on
Razorpay from this chat and gets our lowest price. NO AMOUNT IS QUOTED
here, deliberately. Razorpay owns that number, and a price written in two
places drifts the first time one of them changes - leaving the bot
promising a figure the checkout page contradicts. The bot says 'our lowest
price' and lets the payment page state it.

offer.scarcity_note: limited-time offer for people who reach us on WhatsApp
offer.exclusivity_note: not listed on the website - it only works from this chat
